note: spec/05 §5, the writing half: an engine that wrote a kernel-derived object during `authorize` reports its address on the policy meta, and the kernel copies the list verbatim onto the event payload as `derivedObjects`, beside `policy`, and onto the receipt. The receipt and the record must agree — a list handed to a caller and not recorded would be a claim with no record behind it — and the export lists it, because §5 makes the manifest's `derivedObjects` the union over the payloads.

kind.description: A thing whose admission the deriving test engine decides, and writes a record of.

spec.title: decided, and the decision left an object behind
